# EpicentraX Repository Instructions

Before generating code, editing files, reviewing a change, or proposing architecture:

1. Read `/AGENTS.md`.
2. Read `/docs/ai-context/EPICENTRAX_PROJECT_BRIEF.md`.
3. Read the Constitution and architecture sources named there.

Apply these requirements to every response and change:

- simplest clean solution;
- one source of truth;
- narrow scope;
- no extra fluff;
- database/runtime evidence over code-intent claims;
- preserve identity, security, RLS, audit, and tenant boundaries;
- do not change unrelated files;
- expose uncertainty and stop when a safe fact is missing.
